nodes.label: Proposal 0003: Time-to-consistency as an action-level metric
nodes.description: Status proposed, 2026-10-19, Tier B. Recommendation: define at protocol level in docs/04 before RippleBench v0; implement harness in Phase 3. Needs ADR and eval-auditor sign-off.

nodes.label: Replay harness in bench/
nodes.rationale: After every event of a jobs-track scenario, run the deterministic ranking layer (eligibility + fit + urgency) and record the recommended set and each belief's state. About 200 lines atop the planned bench runner; needs per-event gold states which the jobs track promises.

nodes.label: Time-to-consistency (TTC) metric
nodes.rationale: For each belief gold says should change at event t, count events (and simulated days) until system state matches gold; report distribution and share that never converge. Captures how long a stale belief survives (a stale eligibility surviving a deadline is a missed job). Append-only has infinite TTC; newest-wins has TTC 0 for the direct fact but infinite for dependents: the gap Ripple claims to close (C2). Existing benchmarks STALE and RECON score single questions only.

nodes.label: Stale-action window metric
nodes.rationale: Events during which a recommendation was shown that gold says was stale, summed per scenario. Additive to rate-per-event metrics; LLM judge on transcripts kept only as secondary check.
